Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error during the task decomposition by not adapting its plan when repeated attempts by WebSurfer to retrieve the relevant Wikipedia page resulted in no progress. Instead of switching tactics or agents, the Planner continued issuing the same instructions, leading to a prolonged loop without successful task completion. This repetitive cycle hindered the gathering of the necessary information and should have been adjusted to more effectively ensure the extraction of required details.
